description: Pseudoephedrine, taken the way the box intends. Opens the sinuses, sharpens the edges, and keeps you upright about an hour past where you should have stopped.

effects.onset_message: Your head clears. You can breathe through both sides of your nose, which is more than most people here can say.

overdose.message: It was a cold remedy and you ate it like sweets. Your pulse goes thin and fast and then it doesn't go at all.

phases.comedown_message: The lift drains out and leaves you gritty-eyed.
phases.end_message: You're simply tired now, and your nose is blocked again.

withdrawal.message: Your sinuses shut harder than they were before you opened them.

stages.easing: One side opens and gives you six hours of half a nose, which you spend grateful.
stages.onset: Your nose blocks, on the side that was fine, the way the box said it would after a week.
stages.peak: Solid from the eyebrows down, and your own pulse is the loudest thing in your face.
stages.rising: Both sides now. Breathing through your mouth is drying your throat out and you can hear yourself doing it.
stages.tail: Clear enough to work. It shuts again every time you lie down.

name: pseudoephedrine
